verses.1: I know, brothers, the gospel that I have preached to you. It is the same gospel that you have received and in which you have stood.
verses.2: So that you may be saved, in what way have I been sent to you? Whether you believe or not, that’s up to you.
verses.3: For I have first given you what we also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures.
verses.4: And that he was buried, and that he will be resurrected on the third day according to the scriptures.
verses.5: And that Kefa came, then to the twelve.
verses.6: Then, he was placed above fifty brothers. The majority of them remained awake until morning, while some went to sleep.
verses.7: Then it came to Jacob, and then to all the messengers.
verses.8: But in the end, I still came out as one of those who were against it.
verses.9: For I am the least of all the apostles. I am not worthy to be called an apostle, because I have strived to spread the Church of God.
verses.10: By the grace of God, I am who I am. And His grace has not been wasted on me; rather, I have received more from Him than anyone else could have given me. It’s not that I alone possess God’s grace, but rather, it’s together with me that His grace is present.
verses.11: Whether it’s me or those others, we will proclaim it in that manner, and you should also believe in that manner.
verses.12: But if Christ is proclaimed to have risen from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection from the dead?
verses.13: And if there is no resurrection of the dead, then Christ also does not rise.
verses.14: But if Christ does not come, then our message will be in vain, and your faith will also be in vain.
verses.15: We also find there are false witnesses of God. We have testified against God that Christ was raised from the dead, but He did not rise from the dead unless the dead rise from their deaths.
verses.16: For if the dead do not rise, then neither will Christ rise.
verses.17: But if Christ has not been raised from the dead, then your faith is still in vain, and you remain in your sins.
verses.18: Therefore, those who were asleep in Christ also lost their lives.
verses.19: If in this life, in Christ, they are raised only to heaven, then they are indeed the most blessed among all people.
verses.20: But now, Christ is risen from the dead, before those who were asleep.
verses.21: For death and resurrection through man indeed occur.
verses.22: For just as everyone dies in Adam, so too will everyone be raised to life in Christ.
verses.23: Each one, in his own separate group; first, Christ himself, then those who were with Him during His appearance.
verses.24: And then comes the end: when one gives over their kingdom to God and to parents. When all forms of authority, power, and control are eliminated.
verses.25: For he must rule until he has subdued all his enemies under his feet.
verses.26: The death of an enemy who has been defeated is eliminated.
verses.27: For everything was under his control through his feet. When it is said that everything is under control, it is clear that everything comes from him who controls it.
verses.28: And when he is under the control of someone else, then that son will also be under the control of the person who controls him. In this way, God can have everything in control over everyone.
verses.29: What will the baptized do for those who are dead? If they don’t rise from the dead, then why do they still baptize them?
verses.30: Why do we also risk everything all the time?
verses.31: Every day I die, but I hold onto that glorious hope that I have in Christ Jesus, our Lord.
verses.32: If I fought like a hero in Ephesus, what benefit would that bring to me? If the dead do not rise from their graves, then let us eat and drink. For on that day we will die.
verses.33: Do not be deceived; friendships that are based on deceit will only lead to harm.
verses.34: You have acted justly and do not sin. For some people indeed have ignorance regarding God. I speak to you in good faith.
verses.35: But someone asks: How do the dead rise? And to which body do they return?
verses.36: You who are afraid, you who tremble, will not be safe unless you die.
verses.37: And what you shed is not the body of the future child itself. It’s just a thin layer of skin. If by chance, there’s some blood or other substances from those who are still alive, then that’s also included in this “shedding”.
verses.38: And the God will give him a body as He desires, and each of the birds will have its own distinct body.
verses.39: Not all of those animals are fish; some are humans, some are animals like dogs, and some are fish.
verses.40: And there are also gaseous bodies, and celestial bodies. But one kind of these bodies has more glory than the other.
verses.41: Another glory belongs to the moon, another glory to the sun, and another glory to the stars. For each star has its own glory.
verses.42: And so too is the resurrection of the dead. It is revealed in darkness, and it becomes visible in the end.
verses.43: It is displayed in humility, but it also rises to glory. It is shown in weakness, yet it also gains strength.
verses.44: The physical body is damaged, while the mental body is also affected. If it’s a physical body, then it’s also a mental body.
verses.45: And it is written also: The first man, Adam, lived by his spirit. The last man, Adam, lived by his soul.
verses.46: But first, it’s not the spiritual that comes into play, but rather the psychological. After that, then the spiritual one comes into play.
verses.47: The first person came from the earth, while the second person came from heaven.
verses.48: He who is like a beast, so are also those who are beasts. And he who is like the air, so are also those who are air.
verses.49: And when we put on the image of the chariot, we also put on the image of the sky.
verses.50: I say, brothers, that neither flesh nor blood can inherit the kingdom of God. Nor can corruption inherit decay.
verses.51: I tell you this as a secret: we will not all sleep together, but we will all change.
verses.52: In the eye, in the back of the eye; in the innermost part of the eye. For it will shriek loudly, and the dead will rise from their graves. And we too will be changed.
verses.53: For this decayed thing must wear the guise of decay, and this mortal thing must wear the guise of immortality.
verses.54: When this decaying thing is given the nature of decay, and this mortal thing is given the nature of impermanence, then the law becomes clear. Death is seen as a victory.
verses.55: To you, death, oh victory! To you, death, oh center.
verses.56: But the center of death is sin; and the power of sin is the law.
verses.57: And by the grace of God, through the gift given to us by our Lord Jesus Christ, we may win victory.
verses.58: So, my beloved brothers, become diligent and persistent in your work for the Lord. Always remember that your efforts are not wasted in vain.
